chapter: Honors, Gibson and Dorsey late years
title: Deaths of Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey
summary: Tommy Dorsey chokes on food and dies, and about a year later Jimmy dies of cancer; Leeman sends a telegram to his hospital room.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: It wasn't long after that that Tommy Dorsey choked on some food while he was sleeping and died, and it was no more than ayear later that my dear friend, Jimmy, died in I think it was St. Claire Hospital, New York, of cancer.

Not knowing the seriousness of Jimmy Dorsey's illness when he was in the hospital, and I couldn't get in to visit, I sent him a telegram and I heard The Shadow on the radio playing, The Shadow Knows, I love you, and get well, Cliff -- the telegram said. We had been drinking buddies, also, at the time of my association with his orchestra.
Had I known the seriousness of his illness, I wouldn't have sent that. But maybe he got a smile out of it, anyway.
